title: 第1122章 偶遇顾长风第1121章 北征血渊
slug: 聚灵飞升第1126章暗流之下
content_zh:
血狱岛最高处那座暗红色殿宇的门前，云昊站了一整夜，如同一棵从黑色岩石中生长出来的孤树。
万墟海域的夜色比精玄仙域更加深沉。
灰青色的海面在月光下泛着一层幽冷的光泽，如同无数细碎的银鳞散落在无边无际的水面上，每一点闪烁的光都在诉说着这片海域沉睡时的静谧。
风从北面吹来，带着一丝血渊会残留的淡淡血腥气，正在海风中逐渐消散，那是万墟海域最后一抹属于过去的气息。
云昊没有刻意去感受那些气息，只是站在那座暗红色殿宇的门前，目光越过万墟海域南方的海面落在更远处。
那里是中天仙域的方向，他还从未踏足过那片土地。
天明时分，付荣从身后的殿宇中走出来，站在云昊身边。
没有说话，只是与云昊并肩站着，看向同一片海域，两人就这样站了很久。过了好一会儿付荣才开口：“东西都准备好了。灵舟充了足够的仙晶，地图也拓印了一份完整的。
从这里到中天仙域，正常速度走三年。如果路上不停，两年也能到，但你应该不会急着赶路。”
云昊说：“不用赶。还有二十年，来得及。”
付荣点了点头，没有再多问，转身走回殿宇中。
雷虎和墨羽也已经准备好了。
雷虎站在殿前的石阶上，换了一身干净的灰色战袍，赤红色的纹路在战袍下隐约可见，像是皮肤下流动的岩浆。
正在打磨他的指节，那层老茧已经磨得如同铁铸一般，在晨光中泛着一种久经磨砺的光泽。
墨羽依旧站在殿宇门侧的阴影中，短刀挂在腰间，斗篷的边缘在晨风中轻轻摆动，如同一块被风吹动的黑色岩石。
云昊走下了石阶，目光扫过血狱岛的轮廓。
这座岛屿曾经是血渊会的总舵，也是万墟海域最令人畏惧的地方。
缓步走向码头，脚下暗红色的岩石粗糙而坚实，每一步都踩得很稳。
“走吧。”灵舟再次升空，离开血狱岛，穿过血渊会最南端的边界。
这一次它没有在万墟海域的任何一座岛屿停留，而是径直向南飞去，如同一片落叶在灰青色的海面上划过一道笔直的轨迹。

万墟海域的边界逐渐接近，海水的颜色从暗红变回灰青，又从灰青逐渐变回深蓝，如同在缓慢翻动一本厚重的地图册，每一页都在展示着不同的海域与风貌。
万墟海域在身后渐渐远去。
云昊站在船头看着下方的海面不断变换颜色，深蓝的海水中偶尔能看到巨大的黑影在深处游动，那是万墟海域特有的深海妖兽，它们比精玄仙域的海妖更加古老。
那些黑影在灵舟下方缓缓游过，没有靠近，只是从深海中抬起头看了灵舟一眼，然后重新沉入更深处。
它们似乎感知到了灵舟上那道安静而深沉的气息，选择了退避。
第三天，灵舟抵达了精玄仙域最南端的界壁。
一道淡金色的光幕横亘在天际与海面之间，如同一堵没有厚度的墙。
那堵墙中流动着细密的符文，每一个符文都在按照古老的轨迹缓慢运转。
付荣减缓了灵舟的速度，灵舟穿过界壁时带起一阵轻微的阻力，如同一层薄薄的水幕划过身体。
穿过界壁后，眼前的海域变得比精玄仙域更加开阔，天空的颜色也从淡金变成了一种温润的淡蓝色，没有云层，一直延伸到天地的交界处。
北辰仙域的外围海域中没有岛屿，海面如同一面巨大的镜子，倒映着天空的淡蓝色。
content_en:
In front of the dark red palace at the highest point of Blood Prison Island, Yunhao stood all night, like a lone tree growing out of the black rock.
The night in the Wanxu Sea Territory is darker than that in the Jingxuan Immortal Territory.
The gray-blue sea surface glows with a cold sheen under the moonlight, like countless fine silver scales scattered on the endless water. Every flickering light tells the story of the sleeping tranquility of this sea area.
The wind blows from the north, carrying a faint scent of blood that will remain in the Blood Abyss. It is gradually dissipating in the sea breeze. It is the last scent of the past in the Wanxu Sea.
Yun Hao did not deliberately feel those auras. He just stood in front of the door of the dark red palace, looking across the sea to the south of the Wanxu Sea Area and landing further.
That was the direction of Zhongtian Immortal Realm, and he had never set foot on that land.
At dawn, Fu Rong walked out of the palace behind him and stood next to Yun Hao.
Without speaking, he just stood side by side with Yun Hao, looking at the same sea area. The two stood like this for a long time. After a while, Fu Rong finally spoke: "Everything is ready. The spirit boat has been charged with enough fairy crystals, and a complete rubbing of the map has been made.
From here to Zhongtian Immortal Realm, it takes three years to walk at normal speed. If you don't stop on the road, you can get there in two years, but you shouldn't be in a hurry. "
Yun Hao said: "No need to rush. There are still twenty years, there is still time."
Fu Rong nodded, turned around and walked back to the palace without asking any more questions.
Lei Hu and Mo Yu are also ready.
Lei Hu stood on the stone steps in front of the palace and changed into a clean gray shirt. The red lines were faintly visible under the shirt, like lava flowing under the skin.
He was polishing his knuckles, and the calluses had been worn down as if they were cast iron, giving them a well-honed luster in the morning light.
Mo Yu was still standing in the shadow beside the palace door, with his short knife hanging on his waist, and the edge of his cloak swaying gently in the morning wind, like a black rock blown by the wind.
Yun Hao walked down the stone steps and glanced at the outline of Blood Prison Island.
This island was once the chief rudder of the Blood Abyss Society, and it was also the most feared place in the Wanxu Sea.
Walking slowly towards the pier, the dark red rocks under your feet are rough and solid, and you step on them firmly with every step.
"Let's go." The spirit boat took off again, leaving the Blood Prison Island and passing through the southernmost boundary of the Blood Abyss Society.
This time it did not stop at any island in the Wanxu Sea, but flew straight south, like a fallen leaf tracing a straight trajectory on the gray-green sea.
The boundary of the Wanxu Sea Area is gradually approaching. The color of the sea water changes from dark red to gray-green, and then from gray-green to dark blue. It is like slowly turning the pages of a thick atlas, with each page showing different sea areas and features.
The sea of ​​​​Wanxu gradually fades away behind you.
Yunhao stood on the bow of the ship and watched the sea below constantly changing colors. Occasionally, huge black shadows could be seen swimming in the depths of the deep blue water. They were deep-sea monsters unique to the Wanxu Sea. They were older than the sea monsters in the Jingxuan Immortal Realm.
Those black shadows swam slowly under the spirit boat without getting closer. They just raised their heads from the deep sea and glanced at the spirit boat before sinking deeper again.
They seemed to sense the quiet and deep aura on the spirit boat and chose to retreat.
On the third day, the spirit boat arrived at the southernmost boundary wall of the Jingxuan Immortal Domain.
A pale golden light curtain stretched between the sky and the sea, like a wall without thickness.
Fine runes flowed in that wall, and each rune was slowly moving according to ancient trajectories.
Fu Rong slowed down the speed of the spirit boat. When the spirit boat passed through the boundary wall, it brought a slight resistance, like a thin layer of water curtain across the body.
After passing through the boundary wall, the sea area in front of you became more open than the Jingxuan Immortal Area, and the color of the sky also changed from light gold to a warm light blue, without clouds, extending to the junction of heaven and earth.
There are no islands in the outer sea area of ​​​​Beichen Immortal Domain.The face is like a huge mirror, reflecting the light blue of the sky.
